title: Candy Metric1 Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Festive lights (`festive:lights`), candy counter (`candy:counter`), countdown events (`countdown:event`), Santa tracker (`santa:tracker`).
app: Seasonal novelty feeds — smart Christmas-light power meters, a Halloween candy counter, advent/holiday countdowns, and festive trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and smart plugs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=candy:metric1
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for candy metric1 (1) data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate candy metric1 (1) events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It brings back how your candy metric1 (1) activity added up each month instead of day by day.
